prompt: In many countries, companies are employing fewer permanent staff and are using more short-term contractors and gig workers. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
In today's world, many companies are not giving the permanent jobs to the workers. Instead of this, they are hiring the people for the short time or as a gig workers, for example the drivers and the delivery boys. This development has the positive as well as the negative sides.

On the positive side, the workers are getting the flexibility. They can choose their own timings and they can work for the two or three companies at the same time, so they can earn more money. Also, for the students and the housewives, this type of the work is very suitable because they are having other responsibilities also. From the company side, they can save the money because they do not have to give the pension, the insurance and the paid holidays.

On the negative side, there is no the job security. If the company is not giving the work in some month, the person will not get any income. Also they are not getting the medical benefits and it is very difficult for them to take the loan from the bank, because the bank is asking for the permanent job. Moreover, they can be removed anytime without any notice period. And if they are becoming sick, nobody is paying them for that time, so they are losing the money.

In conclusion, this development has both the advantages and the disadvantages. It is good for the flexibility but it is bad for the security, so the governments should make some rules to protect these workers.
title: Permanent jobs giving way to gig and contract work
